task.notes: t = 1/3 between the brackets (test: E7.75 at t = 1/2 between E7.5 and E8.0).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw_trend_render.what: fgw's draws and positions with every drawn cell of both brackets moved by a per-gene factor to the run profile a trend through all the task's samples gives at the target's day
fgw_trend_render.rule: trend render: each bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor to the run profile a trend through every sample of the task gives at the target's day. A sample's profile is its share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions over the labels every sample holds with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells that are extraembryonic as SERIES_RULE says (the before bracket's groups), weights the moved bracket's label shares; the trend is the least-squares line of log(profile + 1e-5) on the stage day, read at the target's day; the factor is exp(trend) / (own profile + 1e-5), rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged and clipped to 0.25-4, applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1; vec.core.apply_gene_factor). Depth is not moved: the counts outside the panel stay as released

fgw_aligned_trend.what: fgw_aligned (try E10's aligned moves) with fgw_trend_render's expression: every drawn cell of both brackets moved by a per-gene factor to the run profile a trend through all the task's samples gives at the target's day, at the aligned positions
